synth.notes:
Two wall axes on a 21x21 block grid: h row ax (A1/A2), v column ay (A3/A4). A5 cycles h -> v -> pieces in bbox order -> h. A selected piece moves 1 block, bounded by the board and the other pieces.
Pieces mirror across v into solid gray blocks. h-mirrors, diagonal mirrors, and the whole v-mirror of a piece touching the h row are invisible: they erase wall cells and mask targets. Targets are the top layer; a masked target shows only its centre pixel.
Step 268 is not hidden state. The selected piece reaches the h row, so its v-mirror goes invisible, which re-ranks the reflections. The program passes 45/45 with hidden state disabled.
Fix that mattered: an unselected piece hole over a selected-wall dot shows a 0 owned by the piece. When reading selection, use wall-owned dots first.
Not confirmed by data: whether A1/A2 with v selected (and A3/A4 with h) are always no-ops, how axis movement is bounded, and the A5 order with more than 2 pieces.
